coverage.why: Every accounting area and industry_lens carries a finding and verdict, the financial file answers every section plus dupont and path_to_distress, and input_manifest analysis_stages records no drops for analysis_accounting or analysis_financial.

calibration.why: Each area verdict tracks its anomalies (controls 'Weak' over the unremediated weaknesses and presentation errors; estimates 'Mixed' over the reserve release, the savings-plan contradiction and the non-flattering tax and credit items); the one stretch is the factoring-lift wording in the revenue and cash-flow-engineering verdicts, which leans on the unsupported factoring anomaly.

valuation_reading.why: The calculator prints 'no reverse DCF: WACC is not computed' and market.missing, so the reading says price position and implied growth cannot be read, and it names its most-sensitive assumptions by judgment ('no measured sensitivity is read here'), not from a computed grid.
